1.consolidated_definition: En las peleas de gallos, gallo que no se defiende bien, poniendo la cabeza al contrario para que le dé golpes.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In cockfights, a rooster that does not defend itself well, presenting its head to the opponent so as to be struck.
